milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate close enough to the birch fence blocks (placed at the entrance of the oak plank shelter at spawn-relative ~6.5, 1, 8) and face toward them, confirming visual identification. Target is set to the midpoint of the two birch fence blocks. max_distance=16 allows detection from moderate range since the fence is visible from spawn area, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the fence.
